The date of accident is 28.10.2020.
9. It is relevant to know about the problem of VENTRICULOMEGALY.

It is a condition, in which,
the brain ventricles, or fluid-filled cavities, are enlarged due to build up of cerebrospinal fluid (CSF),
CSF is a fluid that protects the brain and spinal cord.
The severity of ventriulomegaly depends on how enlarged the brain is.
In some cases, fluid keeps building up, and the ventricles grow larger over time.
The condition is known as hydrocephalus.
So, the patient who suffers this issue will have neurological disability.
Therefore, 63% as functional disability fixed by the Tribunal is not correct.

However, the intellectual disability refers to neuro developmental conditions that affects functioning in two areas:-
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis
(i) Cognitive functioning, such as learning, problem solving and judgement.
(ii) Adaptive functioning, activities of daily life such as communication skills and social participation.

10. Moreso, it was observed that the intellecutal disability as a life long condition; that the effects of the related conditions are including autism, also known as spectrum disorder, cerebral palsy (CP),
Epilepsy, Attention of Deficit, Hyper Activity Disorder, Impulse Control Disorder and destruction inside disorder.
In injury cases, when the multiplier method is invoked for computing the loss of future income, the claimant is not entitled for the loss of income separately.
In the result, this Civil Miscellaneous Appeal is partly allowed.

(i) The sum of Rs.10,16,600/- awarded by the Tribunal as compensation to the first respondent is hereby reduced to Rs.9,66,600/- along with interest at the rate of 7.5% p.a., from the date of petition till the date of realization.

(ii) The Appellant/Insurance Company is directed to deposit the entire amount now determined by this Court along with interest and costs, https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis ( Uploaded on:
02/07/2025 11:38:34 am ) less the amount already deposited, if any, within a period of six weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this Judgment.
(iii) On such deposit, the 1st respondent is permitted to withdraw the amount awarded by this Court along with interest and costs, less the amount if any, already withdrawn.
No costs.
